title: Dressed-Up 8th Grade Couple on Stage, 1950s B&W Snapshot Photo
description: A vintage black and white snapshot capturing an 8th-grade couple, John Russell and his partner, dressed formally on a stage during a school event or dance in the mid-1950s. The boy wears a bow tie and dark vest, while the girl wears a floor-length tulle dress with short white gloves. In the background, other seated children are visible, some wearing paper crowns.
